_meta.description: Teacher-authored knowledge base for the 77 Banking77 intents. Each intent has an operational definition (as the label is actually used in the dataset, not as its name suggests), its cluster, hand-picked siblings, and the decisive cues that separate it from those siblings. Used to ground CoT traces and to build the system prompt / candidate lists in later phases.

clusters.card_lifecycle: Ordering, delivering, activating, linking and replacing cards
clusters.card_failures: A physical card that does not work at a terminal / merchant
clusters.card_security: Loss, theft, compromise, retention, PINs and app passcodes
clusters.card_payments: Status, fees, disputes and refunds of card / direct-debit payments
clusters.top_up: Adding money to the account (top-ups) and their status / fees
clusters.transfers: Bank transfers in and out of the account
clusters.fx_currency: Currencies, exchange rates and card networks
clusters.identity_account: KYC, account eligibility, personal details, closing the account, wallets

card_arrival.definition: Customer already ordered a card and it has not arrived yet / wants to track it.
card_arrival.cues: past-tense ordering + waiting ('still hasn't come', 'where is my card', 'track'). Prospective 'how long will delivery take' is card_delivery_estimate.

card_delivery_estimate.definition: General question about how long card delivery takes or delivery options/speed, before or right after ordering.
card_delivery_estimate.cues: 'how long', 'how soon', 'express delivery', 'when will I get it' without complaint of lateness.

activate_my_card.definition: How to activate a card that has been received.
activate_my_card.cues: 'activate', 'start using my new card'. Adding an existing/found card to the app is card_linking.

order_physical_card.definition: Wants to order a physical card, including where it can be shipped and what it costs.
order_physical_card.cues: 'order a card', 'can you ship to <country>', first physical card. PIN questions for an arrived card are get_physical_card.

get_physical_card.definition: Dataset usage: where to find / how to get the PIN for a newly received physical card.
get_physical_card.cues: 'where is my PIN', 'is the PIN sent with the card', 'how do I know my PIN'. Changing an existing PIN is change_pin; locked PIN is pin_blocked.

getting_spare_card.definition: Wants an additional / spare / second card on the account (for self or family).
getting_spare_card.cues: 'another card', 'extra card', 'spare', 'second card', 'card for my partner'.

card_about_to_expire.definition: Card is expiring / expired; how to get a replacement and whether it costs anything.

card_linking.definition: Adding/linking a card to the app, including re-linking a card that was lost and then found.
card_linking.cues: 'link', 'add card to the app', 'found my card again, can I use it'.

card_not_working.definition: Card does not work in general, no specific cause or context (not explicitly declined abroad, not contactless, not PIN).
card_not_working.cues: 'my card doesn't work', 'card is broken/damaged', 'card stopped working'. Explicit 'declined' at a merchant leans declined_card_payment. Dataset convention: 'declined at X, what's wrong with my card?' (card-focused) is card_not_working; 'why was my payment declined?' (transaction-focused) is declined_card_payment.

contactless_not_working.definition: Tap / contactless payments specifically fail while chip-and-PIN may work.

declined_card_payment.definition: A card payment at a merchant/shop/online was declined or rejected.
declined_card_payment.cues: 'declined', 'rejected', 'payment didn't go through' at a merchant, when buying something with the card.

card_acceptance.definition: Where the card can be used / is accepted (merchants, online, abroad).
card_acceptance.cues: 'where can I use my card', 'will it be accepted', 'can I shop online with it'. Which countries the service is offered in is country_support.

pin_blocked.definition: PIN is blocked / locked, usually after too many wrong attempts; how to unblock.

change_pin.definition: Wants to change / reset their card PIN.
change_pin.cues: 'change my PIN', 'new PIN', 'reset PIN' without being blocked; ATM where PIN can be changed.

passcode_forgotten.definition: Forgot the app passcode/password used to log in; needs to reset it.
passcode_forgotten.cues: 'passcode', 'password', 'can't log in to the app'. Card PIN is a different intent.

lost_or_stolen_card.definition: Physical card has been lost or stolen.
lost_or_stolen_card.cues: 'lost', 'stolen', 'misplaced', 'can't find my card'. Retained by an ATM is card_swallowed; details used by someone while card is in hand is compromised_card.

compromised_card.definition: Card details may have been stolen/used fraudulently or the card is otherwise compromised (customer still has it).
compromised_card.cues: 'someone is using my card', 'fraud', 'hacked', 'security breach', 'details leaked'. A single specific unknown payment leans card_payment_not_recognised.

card_swallowed.definition: An ATM kept / swallowed / retained the card.

lost_or_stolen_phone.definition: Phone with the banking app was lost or stolen; how to secure the account.
lost_or_stolen_phone.cues: 'lost my phone', 'phone stolen', 'someone has my phone'.

getting_virtual_card.definition: How to get / order a (standard, non-disposable) virtual card, and its cost.

get_disposable_virtual_card.definition: How to get a disposable / single-use virtual card.

disposable_card_limits.definition: Limits or rules of disposable cards: how many can be made, how many uses, expiry.
disposable_card_limits.cues: 'how many disposable cards', 'how many times can I use', 'limit' + disposable.

virtual_card_not_working.definition: Virtual card fails / is not accepted when paying.

pending_card_payment.definition: A card payment is still showing as pending.
pending_card_payment.cues: 'pending' + purchase/payment at merchant, 'how long until payment completes'.

reverted_card_payment?.definition: A card payment was reverted / cancelled / returned to the account and customer asks why.
reverted_card_payment?.cues: 'reverted', 'cancelled', 'money came back' for a card PAYMENT (not a top-up).

card_payment_not_recognised.definition: A card payment on the statement that the customer does not recognise.
card_payment_not_recognised.cues: 'payment I didn't make', 'don't recognise this purchase'. Withdrawal -> cash_withdrawal_not_recognised; direct debit -> direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.definition: An unrecognised direct debit on the account.

card_payment_fee_charged.definition: A fee was charged on a card payment (e.g. paying in a foreign currency / above limit).
card_payment_fee_charged.cues: 'fee' + 'card payment/purchase'. Unexplained small extra charge without context is extra_charge_on_statement.

extra_charge_on_statement.definition: An unexplained extra charge / fee (often a small £1-type amount) appears on the statement.
extra_charge_on_statement.cues: 'extra charge', 'extra pound', 'strange fee on my statement', 'paid more than the price'.

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.definition: Wrong / unfavourable exchange rate applied to a card payment abroad or in foreign currency.

transaction_charged_twice.definition: Same transaction was charged twice / duplicated.

request_refund.definition: Wants to get a refund for a purchase / how to request one.
request_refund.cues: 'refund', 'return item and get money back', 'can I get my money back' (initiating).

Refund_not_showing_up.definition: A refund a merchant issued does not appear in the account yet.
Refund_not_showing_up.cues: 'refund not showing', 'still waiting for refund', 'merchant says refunded'.

atm_support.definition: Which ATMs accept the card / where to withdraw cash.
atm_support.cues: 'which ATMs', 'can I use any ATM', 'where can I withdraw'.

pending_cash_withdrawal.definition: A cash withdrawal still shows as pending.

declined_cash_withdrawal.definition: ATM declined the withdrawal / could not get cash.

cash_withdrawal_charge.definition: Fee charged for an ATM withdrawal, or question about withdrawal fees.

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.definition: A cash withdrawal on the statement the customer did not make.

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.definition: ATM dispensed less (or different) cash than requested/debited.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received.cues: 'ATM gave me less', 'didn't get all my money', 'wrong amount of cash'.

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.definition: Wrong exchange rate / overcharged on a foreign-currency ATM withdrawal.

automatic_top_up.definition: Setting up or using auto top-up.
automatic_top_up.cues: 'auto top-up', 'automatically top up', 'when balance is low'.

topping_up_by_card.definition: Adding money to the account with a debit/credit card, or letting others top up the account; how card top-ups work. (Noisy label in the dataset.)
topping_up_by_card.cues: 'top up with card', 'use my credit card to add money', 'can others top up my account'.

top_up_by_card_charge.definition: Fee charged for topping up with a card.

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.definition: Fee charged for topping up via bank transfer.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.cues: 'fee' + 'top up / add money' + 'bank transfer'. A fee on sending money out is transfer_fee_charged.

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.definition: Whether/how money can be added with cash or a cheque.

top_up_failed.definition: Top-up attempt failed / was declined / did not work.

top_up_reverted.definition: Top-up appeared to succeed but was reverted/cancelled afterwards; money disappeared.

pending_top_up.definition: Top-up still showing as pending / not yet completed.
pending_top_up.cues: 'top-up pending', 'top-up still processing', 'how long does top-up take'.

verify_top_up.definition: Verifying a card used for top-up (verification code on the card statement).
verify_top_up.cues: 'verify top-up', 'top-up verification code', 'code on my statement'.

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.definition: Deposited cash or a cheque but the balance has not updated.

transfer_into_account.definition: How to transfer / add money into the account by bank transfer (how-to).
transfer_into_account.cues: 'how do I transfer money into my account', 'deposit via bank transfer' (self-funding).

receiving_money.definition: Receiving money from others (friends, salary), including in other currencies.

transfer_timing.definition: General question about how long transfers take to arrive (no specific stuck transfer).
transfer_timing.cues: 'how long do transfers take', 'when will it arrive' (generic, often international/SEPA).

pending_transfer.definition: An outgoing transfer is still showing as pending.

failed_transfer.definition: A transfer failed / did not go through / bounced back.

declined_transfer.definition: A transfer was explicitly declined / rejected.

cancel_transfer.definition: Wants to cancel / stop / reverse a transfer (often sent by mistake).

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.definition: Outgoing transfer completed on customer's side but the recipient has not received it.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient.cues: 'recipient/friend/landlord hasn't received', 'they didn't get my transfer'.

beneficiary_not_allowed.definition: Cannot add a beneficiary / transfer to a specific account is not allowed.
beneficiary_not_allowed.cues: 'beneficiary', 'can't add payee', 'not allowed to transfer to this account'.

transfer_fee_charged.definition: Fee charged on a transfer, or question about transfer fees.

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.definition: Money transferred INTO the account (top-up by bank transfer / incoming) has not shown in the balance.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.cues: 'transfer to my account not showing', 'balance not updated', 'made a transfer from my other bank'.

exchange_rate.definition: What exchange rates are used / how they are determined (informational).
exchange_rate.cues: 'what exchange rate do you use', 'is the rate good', no complaint about a specific transaction.

exchange_via_app.definition: How to exchange currency within the app.
exchange_via_app.cues: 'exchange currency', 'convert USD to GBP', 'how do I exchange'.

fiat_currency_support.definition: Which fiat currencies the account can hold / supports.
fiat_currency_support.cues: 'which currencies can I hold', 'do you support <currency>', 'multi-currency'.

supported_cards_and_currencies.definition: Which cards and currencies are accepted for adding money (top-up sources).
supported_cards_and_currencies.cues: 'which cards/currencies are accepted for top up', 'can I top up with a US card'.

visa_or_mastercard.definition: Whether the bank's card is Visa or Mastercard / choosing the network.

verify_my_identity.definition: How to verify identity / what documents are needed (process).
verify_my_identity.cues: 'how do I verify', 'what ID do I need', 'verification process'.

why_verify_identity.definition: Why identity verification is required (motivation / complaint about being asked).
why_verify_identity.cues: 'why do I need to verify', 'why do you need my ID', 'is this necessary'.

unable_to_verify_identity.definition: Identity verification is failing / not accepted / stuck.
unable_to_verify_identity.cues: 'can't verify', 'verification failed', 'ID not accepted', 'won't let me verify'.

verify_source_of_funds.definition: Asked to (or asking how to) prove the source of funds / where money comes from.
verify_source_of_funds.cues: 'source of funds', 'where my money came from', 'proof of income'.

age_limit.definition: Minimum age to open/use an account (including for children).

edit_personal_details.definition: Change personal details such as name, address, email or phone number.

terminate_account.definition: Wants to close / delete the account.

country_support.definition: Which countries the service / account is available in.
country_support.cues: 'which countries', 'available in <country>', 'can I open an account if I live in'.

apple_pay_or_google_pay.definition: Using / setting up Apple Pay or Google Pay (or problems with them).
